component.name: VitexSoftware Debian Repository
component.summary: APT repository providing development tools, business applications, and system utilities

description.p: Official APT repository maintained by VitexSoftware, offering packages for Debian and Ubuntu distributions.
Supported distributions: Bookworm, Bullseye, Buster, Trixie, Focal, Jammy, Noble.
Notable software includes the AbrAFlexi accounting suite, Apache NetBeans, VSCodium, draw.io, step-cli, Aptly, and various PHP libraries and system administration tools.
Repository URL: https://repo.vitexsoftware.com/ GPG key: https://repo.vitexsoftware.com/KEY.gpg
